description:
When Bono sat down with Joe Rogan on his podcast, he didn’t hold back.
He called music “the language of the spirits” and straight-up said — it’s worship. But who, exactly, is being worshipped? In this episode, we dig into Bono’s words, U2’s lyrics, and the spiritual undercurrent flowing through the music industry. Is this inspiration from above… or something far more deceptive?
